segments.opening_question_spark: If the island has food and water, why can't you stay forever?
segments.entry_transition: The torn shelter gives the clue: supplies cannot stop storms or every danger.
segments.body_01: Storms can rip shelters apart and ruin tools.
segments.body_02: Strong sun and heat can harm your body.
segments.body_03: A bad injury can become dangerous without medical care.
segments.body_04: Infection can become serious without treatment.
segments.body_05: Storms can spoil food or cut off fresh water.
segments.body_06: Rescue may not arrive when you need it.
segments.body_07: Even in perfect safety, your body would still age.
segments.optional_closing: Supplies can extend survival, but they cannot make life endless.
